method: Codex computer use with native accessibility tree and keyboard/pointer input

observations.description: Final Debug app relaunched to an inactive private workspace.
Starting private browsing selected one blank tab and focused the labeled native address field.
Typing and submitting a local address loaded Alpha with query and fragment preserved.
Clicking Beta, Back and Forward produced the expected active page and history control state.
Native tab context menu pinned Beta. The selected row exposed a Pinned value, title and distinct close label.
Command-T created and selected a blank tab and returned focus to the address field.
Reload was invoked. No independent reload request counter was collected.
The native sidebar toggle hid sidebar controls and retained address focus.
The first accessibility build duplicated row names. The final rebuild exposed the page title and distinct close label.
